# Contributing to Kolwen-AI

Issues, bug reports and pull requests are welcome in every Kolwen-AI repository. A repository's own `CONTRIBUTING.md` wins where it has one; this is the default for the rest.

1. **Open an issue first** for anything beyond a typo: the problem, the gap or the change you want.
2. **Follow the repository's gates.** Its `CONTRIBUTING.md` or README names the commands.
3. **Send a pull request.** Its template is the checklist.

Everyone taking part follows the [Contributor Covenant](https://github.com/Kolwen-AI/.github/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). New to open source? The [Open Source Guides](https://opensource.guide/) explain how contributing works. Who decides and how a change is accepted: [governance](https://github.com/Kolwen-AI/.github/blob/main/.github/GOVERNANCE.md).

Contributions are licensed under the repository's own outbound licence; there is no separate CLA. This is a small team: replies are best effort, with no promised turnaround. Security reports never go in a public issue; see the [security policy](https://github.com/Kolwen-AI/.github/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md).
